subject.title: Feature: Project trees + threaded entry points in Control UI

question: Should OpenClaw add structural selected-message split/copy and multi-target composer routing beyond the current custom groups, quote replies, and whole-session forks?
rationale: The remaining capabilities change durable transcript identity, session routing, failure handling, and potentially project isolation; current code does not establish the intended product semantics.

options.title: Narrow this issue
options.body: Keep this issue as the canonical design for selected-message split/copy and routed composer behavior, with custom groups recorded as implemented.

options.title: Create focused follow-ups
options.body: Create separate canonical issues for transcript branching and multi-target routing, then supersede this broad umbrella.

options.title: Stop at current primitives
options.body: Treat custom groups, quote replies, and whole-session forks as the supported product boundary without message moves or fanout.

recommendation.title: Narrow this issue
recommendation.body: Keep this issue as the canonical design for selected-message split/copy and routed composer behavior, with custom groups recorded as implemented.
